comment: Read from the repository at commit c3db83a, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.2. Neither the inputs nor the outputs are given a family: a channel carries whatever you patch into it, audio or control voltage alike, and the mix carries the same. The knob's default value depends on the switch beside it, reset to zero in attenuator mode and to the centre in attenuverter mode, which is updated every 128 samples at line 131. The chaining works by a running sum that is zeroed after any output that has a cable in it, at lines 162 to 167, so an unpatched output still carries the mix that would have gone into the next channel; the polyphony count is spread across the chained channels at lines 112 to 124 so that a chain all carries the same number of channels. The left expander is another GOMA II: the sum reaches this module through the expander message, so the two must be next to each other with this one on the right.
